[ffff64]Witch's Woods[ffffff]
P-Pelulu...You ran too fast...\nI'm already exhausted just to get here...
I-it's still scary even if the ghost is gone, so\nI ran at full speed...
These woods seem scary...\nThere won't be any ghosts, will there?
There's no ghost, but I heard there's a witch who\nhas lived since long before the Cataclysm. She was\nonce persecuted and accused of being a bad witch.
But because she risked her life to help save this\nworld with magic, the Goddess of Wisdom, Pino, who\nwas a consul at that time restored her reputation.
Whoaat?! So she's been alive for centuries?\nThat dried up old hag must be looking like a\nliving mummy now, don't you think so??
...Brrr! Even if she's not a ghost, I don't wanna\nrun into her if it's possible...
...You're right. Let's split up and collect the\nFragrant Gravels quickly so that we can get to\nNov Diela faster...
Reliza, you're so knowledgeable about what\nhappened in the past. Also that story about the\nwitch, it's like you've seen her firsthand...
That's, uh, umm...
Besides, when we asked the Injes to move, I\nremember you said "Let me convey the message from\nKing Elbano IV!".
That was the name of the ancient king before the\nCataclysm happened, you know?\n...Hmm~, could you possibly...
You're really into history books and get so\nabsorbed in them, right? That's why you confused\nthe ancient king's name with the current one.
Yes? Oh, um, yeah. It's a bad habit...I got too\nexcited at that time and said the wrong name...\nIt's embarrassing.
I knew it. Ahaha, but it seems like nobody else\nnoticed it, so it's fine.
Oops, sorry for delaying you with such a trivial\nmatter. Let's go!
Tee-hee-hee-hee...
A bewitching beautiful lady appeared out of the\ndarkness. If you look closely, you can see her\nleft eye being covered with an eyepatch...
Oh, it's unusual to see a visitor here.\nWhat do you need, kiddo?
...Uh? Oh, yeah.\nI'm Rita, the guardian of this Witch's Woods.
...Tee-hee-hee-hee, oh gosh, that thing happened a\nlong time ago. I can't believe that there are\nstill people who know about it.
If not scholars who have done a lot of research in\nhistory, then they must be monsters that have\nsurvived for ages. Both of them are weird anyway.
So? When you heard about the witch who has lived\nfor centuries, you thought she would look like a\nmummy? Tehee, I'm afraid I don't look like one...
By the way, what brings you to a place like this?
You told her that you came to collect some\nFragrant Gravels to defeat the monsters in the\nwetlands...
Ohh, I see. There are many monsters that have\nFragrant Gravels here, feel free to collect\nas many as you want...
Since you're already here, do you mind if I ask\nyou to help me?
Actually, a huge monster had recently appeared out\nof nowhere in the depths of the woods...
I've already made a barrier so that it can't\nescape, but since it's dangerous, can you please\nget rid of it?
Okay.
Sorry, but no.
Tee-hee-hee...I knew you would say yes.\nOkay then, sorry for the trouble but I'm counting\non you!
Oh, come on, don't treat me so coldly.\nDon't just think of it as a burden. Who knows,\nyou might get something valuable instead...
All right.
But still, no thank you.
Tee-hee-hee...I knew you would understand.\nOkay then, sorry for the trouble but I'm counting\non you!
Oh, come on, don't treat me so coldly.\nDon't just think of it as a burden. Who knows,\nyou might get something valuable instead...
Oh, hi again, kiddo...\nWhaat?! You have already beat it?\nYou're no ordinary adventurer.
Now I can finally live in peace, thank you...\nSo, where are you headed next?
...I see, be careful then.\nJust remember to treasure your life, okay?
Aye, you're back!\nDon't you think you were taking a little too much\ntime?
What took you so long?!
What took you so long?!...You were helping\nsomeone? Stop joking around! There can't be any\nhuman in such an eerie forest...Brrr...
Well, whatever. We've wasted quite some time here,\nlet's hurry to Nov Diela!
